name: Cuetzmonquali
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

perception.note: Greater darkvision, Scent 60ft imprecise, smoke vision

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Follower of the Flame
defensiveAbilities.description: Cuetzmonquali recognizes the might of the wielder of the Spear of the Destroyer's Flame. Out of its respect for that strength, it follows the commands of the spear's wielder and can understand the wielder, regardless of the language the wielder speaks.

defensiveAbilities.name: Searing Skin
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. Cuetzmonquali's flesh burns as hot as flame. Creatures that end their turn in the emanation take 4d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 35 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
defensiveAbilities.description: Smoke doesn't impair Cuetzmonquali's vision; it ignores concealment from smoke.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: Cuetzmonquali unleashes a blast of fire that deals 12d10 Fire Damage damage in a 50ft Cone (Basic DC 38 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that fail their saves catch on fire and take 1d12 Persistent,fire Damage damage. Cuetzmonquali can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Burning Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 Poison Damage]{4d6 poison plus 2d10 fire}, and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 Poison Damage]{6d6 poison plus 3d10 fire}, and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 Poison Damage]{8d6 poison plus 4d10 fire}, and Enfeebled 3 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d6+8) Bludgeoning Damage]{2d6+8 bludgeoning damage plus 2d10 fire damage}, Basic DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw save

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Sting
offensiveAbilities.description: Cuetzmonquali makes two tail Strikes, each targeting a different creature. These attacks count toward Cuetzmonquali's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Impaling Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: Cuetzmonquali charges forward and attempts to gore a foe. It Strides and attempts a horn Strike. On a hit, the target becomes impaled on one of Cuetzmonquali's horns. The creature becomes Grabbed. If Cuetzmonquali moves, it brings the grabbed creature along with it. Cuetzmonquali doesn't need to use additional actions to keep the creature grabbed; the creature remains grabbed as long as it's impaled. The grabbed creature can attempt to Escape as normal, but the DC to do so is 40, rather than Cuetzmonquali's Athletics DC. If Cuetzmonquali critically hit the creature to impale it, that creature is Restrained for 1 round, in addition to being grabbed and impaled as per a success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Large or smaller, claw, Basic DC 38 Reflex Saving Throw save

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead spend an action to use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
